owned_invariants: Tests run the real pfp_operad binary on run folders written by the WF1-WF5 runners; none replaces the host's verdict with a Python one.
A rule is taken from a recorded WF1 failure to an admission through paired runs, and a later WF1 run is asserted to carry it in its prompt, to replay, and to pass the host's seed check.
With no admitted rule the loaded task is asserted equal to the original and its prepared prompt identical.
Unfair trials (a treated arm without the rule, two different cases, the case the rule came from under another task id) are asserted refused by code, with the ledger file unchanged.
WF2, WF3 and WF4 are asserted to run a loaded task; WF5 is asserted to refuse its seed with WF5_UNSUPPORTED_SEED_LANGUAGE.
boundaries: Offline fixtures only; fixtures are not live model trials.
The WF4 scripted gateway is bound to one task, so the loaded WF4 run patches that binding.

score.level_basis: L2 verification support: explicit fixtures and finite negative controls with source-bound outcomes.

basis.G1: Each test name states the claim it checks.
basis.G2: Expected statuses, codes and counts follow from the replies written in the test.
basis.G3: Refusals are asserted by the host's code, and the exit code of the command is asserted for a pass, a refusal and a host that did not run.
basis.G4: All 9 pass in the recorded run; they killed 34 of 34 eligible transport mutants.
basis.G5: Measured worst cyclomatic 9, cognitive 2, nesting 2; ceiling A+, recorded A.

evidence.note: 689 offline tests (pfp/workflows, pfp_core/workflow_families, exclusions) against the release build of pfp_operad 0.6.0; exact source inputs bound. No live model performance claim.
